entry.title: Layout modes
entry.summary: Terminal-Pub can list your posts in four ways. Pick one for the whole site under Theme settings → Layout → Layout mode, or give a…
entry.content:
Terminal-Pub can list your posts in four ways. Pick one for the whole site under Theme settings → Layout → Layout mode, or give a single tag its own layout with Tag → Other options → Custom template. The View menu above shows this site’s posts in each of them.

  • Full: Terminal’s classic look. Title, details, the featured image at full width (at most 16:9 high) and the excerpt. See the Full view.
  • Half: image on the left; title, details and a four-line excerpt on the right. No featured image? The first image in the post is used. See the Half view.
  • Compact: text only. Date, word count and tags on one line, a large title and a three-line excerpt. See the Compact view.
  • List: the date on the left, the title with its tags and word count on the right, all one size. Made for archives. See the List view.

Related settings: Frame around images (Full and Half), List: text size (List) and Corner radius (every image). The posts below use images of different shapes, so you can see how each layout handles a portrait, a panorama, an icon-size picture and a post whose only image sits in the text.

entry.title: A quiet morning in the terminal
entry.summary: The kettle is on, the editor is open and the cursor blinks where yesterday ended. A plain text file, a short list of things to…
entry.content:
The kettle is on, the editor is open and the cursor blinks where yesterday ended. A plain text file, a short list of things to try and nothing else on the screen: that is the whole plan for the morning.

This post has a standard 16:9 featured image, the shape most cameras and screenshots give you. In every layout it fills its space without being cropped.

entry.title: Notes on spacing
entry.summary: Most of a page is empty space, and the empty space decides how the rest reads. Terminal-Pub keeps the original type scale and only tightens…
entry.content:
Most of a page is empty space, and the empty space decides how the rest reads. Terminal-Pub keeps the original type scale and only tightens the gaps between blocks, so a list of posts reads as one column rather than a pile of cards.

Switch the layout mode and watch how the same spacing holds in Half, Compact and List.

entry.title: Colour schemes in practice
entry.summary: Pick an accent, then Dark, Light or Custom. The background on Dark is mixed from the accent, the way Hugo Terminal does it, so every…
entry.content:
Pick an accent, then Dark, Light or Custom. The background on Dark is mixed from the accent, the way Hugo Terminal does it, so every accent gets its own slightly tinted night.

Readable small text is one switch away if you prefer every detail at full contrast.

entry.title: Writing in two languages
entry.summary: Bilingual posts keep both languages in one page, behind two tabs. The word count counts one of them, the reader picks the other with a…
entry.content:
Bilingual posts keep both languages in one page, behind two tabs. The word count counts one of them, the reader picks the other with a click, and the choice is remembered on the next post.

Tabs follow the WAI-ARIA pattern, so screen readers announce them properly.

entry.title: Edge case: a portrait image
entry.summary: A tall image. Full shows it at most 16:9 high and trims the top and bottom; Half fills its column at the height of the…
entry.content: A tall image. Full shows it at most 16:9 high and trims the top and bottom; Half fills its column at the height of the text and crops the rest. The picture is never stretched.

entry.title: Edge case: a panorama
entry.summary: A wide, low image. Full keeps its shape at full width; Half crops the sides so it still fills the space next to the title.
entry.content: A wide, low image. Full keeps its shape at full width; Half crops the sides so it still fills the space next to the title.

entry.title: Edge case: an icon-size image
entry.summary: A 64 pixel image, the size of an icon. Enlarged it would turn blurry, so both Full and Half keep it at its own size…
entry.content: A 64 pixel image, the size of an icon. Enlarged it would turn blurry, so both Full and Half keep it at its own size and centre it.

entry.title: Typography and rhythm
entry.summary: Terminal-Pub keeps the original Terminal type scale and just tightens the vertical spacing. Here is how the common elements look. Body text sits on a…
entry.content:
Terminal-Pub keeps the original Terminal type scale and just tightens the vertical spacing. Here is how the common elements look.

A second-level heading

Body text sits on a baseline grid. Links use the accent colour, bold uses the bold weight, and italic uses the italic face when the font ships one.

A third-level heading

A blockquote is bordered top and bottom, with a > marker in the accent colour.

  • Unordered items get an accent dash
  • Nesting works
    • like this
  1. Ordered items are counted
  2. in the margin

Inline code and a block:

function hello(name) {
  return `Hi, ${name}`;
}
